page.overview:
What is Allen's Encounter?

Allen's Encounter is a critical event in the Coalition of Planets' history, of when Allen encountered a unnamed Viltrumite, but was easily defeated.

At some point after Allen's birth, when he was a "super soldier" for the Coalition of Planets. He encountered a Viltrumite, Allen, thinking he was just as strong, fought him but Allen underestimated the Viltrumites strength and was defeated. This incident lead to the Unopan Breeding Experiments shutting down as they deemed the project a failure. After this, Allen recovered and was assigned to be a Evaluation Officer for the Coalition of Planets.
